description: This file defines the main tracking page component for a package shipment tracking UI using React. It includes state management, effect hooks, API calls for fetching shipment details, and rendering of tracking information and UI elements.

methods.name: TrackingPage
methods.description: React functional component that manages the tracking page, allowing users to input tracking numbers, fetch shipment details, and display tracking progress.

methods.name: searchSingle
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches shipment data based on a single tracking number and updates the state.

methods.name: searchMany
methods.description: Splits multiple tracking numbers, fetches their shipment details, and updates the list of shipments.
